## Print notes

- **Dev-board dock**: Plate on the bed, no supports, 0.2 mm layers, 3 walls, 15% infill. Pegs are 2.35/1.7 mm: print slower for the top 3 mm or ream with a drill.
- **Solder station insert**: Upright, no supports, 3 walls, 10-15% infill. Round trough bottoms print as steep overhangs and come out fine; the 1 mm ribs between pockets need 0.4 mm nozzle.
- **Small-parts grid 4x4**: Upright, no supports, 2 walls, 15% infill.

## How it works

Drop-in inserts: trays that sit on a crate floor and turn a generic crate into a kit.

Every insert is modelled in its own frame (centered on XY, bottom at z = 0) and is
meant to sit at z = FLOOR_Z inside the crate it names. Inserts keep CLEARANCE per side
to the cavity walls and stay below the stacking seat (`size.lip_top - SEAT_DEPTH`),
so a crate or cap still stacks on top.
